title: Compatibility sweep for newly onboarded models: streaming + function/tool-calling
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: As we onboard a new set of community and partner models into the model catalog we must ensure each model variant (model vX, quantized builds, and pinned revisions) behaves correctly when used with streaming responses and the function/tool-calling surface. Several recent customer reports showed edge-case failures when a model switch occurred mid-stream and when function schema negotiation differed between client/SDK versions.

Goal: Run a structured compatibility sweep across the newly onboarded models and their pinned versions to verify: streaming behavior (SSE, chunked, and server-initiated resumptions), function/tool calling (schema validation, multiple tool responses, error propagation), and correct publishing of performance profiles to the catalog. Produce clear pass/fail results, remediation steps for failures, and publish the verified model+profile entries.

Scope: 1) Top-30 newly onboarded models in onboarding-queue, including quantized variants (fp16/int8). 2) All supported streaming modes (SSE, chunked, websocket proxy). 3) Function/tool calling permutations: single-tool, multi-tool, tool-fallback, tool-error flows. 4) Version pinning cases: pinned-old -> pinned-new rollouts, and cross-version fallbacks.

Success criteria: - No silent truncation or malformed JSON in streamed function-call responses across >95% of test permutations. - Performance profile published for each model variant and verified in catalog UI with latency/token metrics matching baseline within +/-15%. - Any failing model has an assigned remediation task with TTR <= 5 business days.
acceptance_criteria: A test matrix completed for all top-30 onboarded models covering streaming modes x function call permutations x pinned versions
All streaming responses deliver syntactically valid JSON when function/tool-calling is used (no partial/corrupt function arguments), or documented graceful degradation behavior verified
Performance profiles are published to the model catalog for each verified model variant and surface latency/throughput numbers in runtime-1.22 dashboards
A remediation ticket exists for each failing permutation and is triaged with owner and ETA
Automated end-to-end tests added to onboarding CI to prevent regressions for the verified permutations
test_plan: 1) Populate test harness with pinned model revisions from onboarding queue. 2) Drive streaming scenarios: SSE and chunked HTTP streaming, replicating client disconnects and mid-stream fallback to alternate model. 3) Execute function/tool call flows using schema v1 and v2 fixtures, including: correct argument passing, partial-argument recovery, tool-error propagation. 4) Measure latency and token throughput under steady-state and burst traffic; record into performance profile templates. 5) Run CI gate that replays failing permutations against latest runtime branch before merge.
rollout_plan: Publish verified profiles to model catalog with tag 'verified-2025-02'. For models that failed non-blocking issues, publish with 'verified-limited' and add UI warning in catalog entries. Coordinate with DX to notify SDK teams if schema incompatibilities require minor client updates. Monitor 72h after publish for unexpected error spikes via alert channel #prod-inference-alerts.
